VAR_RunStartTicks.description:
Stores the start timestamp of the current flow run.

Used for:
- Audit duration calculations
- Processing duration measurements
- Run summary statistics

Naming convention aligned with Agent 1.

Example:
2026-07-07 09:42:15 UTC

VAR_AuditEvents.description:
Stores structured audit events before writing them to AuditTrail.xlsx.

Contains: TimestampUtc, WorkflowPath, StepName, StepStatus, User, SourceFileName, TargetFileName, TargetFolder, DurationSec, Decision.

Written to AuditTrail.xlsx at the end.

VAR_NewStepsCount.description: Holds the incremented Steps counter value while writing it to Agent Audit Summary.

VAR_NewRunsCount.description: Holds the incremented Runs counter value while writing it to Agent Audit Summary.

VAR_StepCounter.description:
Default = 0

Stores sequential process step numbers.

Used to generate:
EMREPORT-001
EMREPORT-002
EMREPORT-003

Provides chronological order within AuditTrail.xlsx.

VAR_InitiatedBy.description:
Stores the email address of the Power Apps user who triggered this upload.

Used for:
- Audit trail
- Alert mails
- Power Apps response messages

VAR_SourceFileName.description:
Stores the original uploaded file name received from Power Apps.
Used for:

- Extension validation
- Audit trail
- Alert mails
- Power Apps response messages

CMP_SourceFileName.description:
Extracts the original filename received from Power Apps.

Used for:
- Extension validation
- Audit trail
- Error handling
- Success logging

CMP_FileExtension.description:
Extracts the uploaded file extension from the source filename.
Used for:

- File type validation
- Upload rejection
- User feedback
- Audit trail

LIST_Worksheets_WorkFile.description: Reads all worksheets from the newly uploaded Emergency Report workbook.

FILTER_EmergencyContactsWorksheet.description: Finds the required Emergency Contacts worksheet within the uploaded workbook's worksheet list.

SET_AppResponseCode_(Success).description: Sets the Power Apps response code after successful validation, productive release, and cleanup.

SET_AppResponseMessage_(Success).description: Sets the Power Apps success message after the Emergency Report was validated and released.

SET_AppResponseStatus_(Success).description: Sets the Power Apps response status after successful processing.

SET_AuditOutcome_(Success).description: Marks the Agent 3 run as succeeded after validation, productive release, and cleanup were completed.

CREATE_EmergencyReport.description: Creates the productive Emergency Report after successful validation (workbook readability, required worksheet, existing productive file removed if present). This file is consumed by Agent 1.

DELETE_ExistingFile.description:
Deletes the existing productive Emergency Report before releasing the validated workbook.

Executed only if the productive target file already exists.

IF_EmergencyReportExists.description: Checks whether an existing productive Emergency Report must be removed before releasing the validated workbook.

GET_TargetFileMetadata.description:
Checks whether the productive Emergency Report already exists in the Agent 1 monitored target folder.

This action is executed only after successful workbook and worksheet validation.

SET_WorkbookValidationPassed_(True).description: Marks the Emergency Report workbook validation as successful.

SET_AppResponseCode_(MissingWorksheet).description: Sets the machine-readable response code for the missing-worksheet failure case.

inputs.name: AppResponseMessage
inputs.value: Invalid Emergency Report. Worksheet '@{trim(string(outputs('CMP_ConfigObject')?['RequiredWorksheetName']))}' was not found.

SET_AppResponseMessage_(MissingWorksheet.description: Sets the Power Apps response message for the missing-worksheet failure case.

SET_AppResponseStatus_(MissingWorksheet).description: Sets the Power Apps response status for the missing-worksheet failure case.

SET_AuditOutcome_(Failed)_-_MissingWorks.description: Sets the overall audit outcome to Failed because the uploaded workbook is invalid.

SET_AlertMailSubject_(MissingWorksheet).description: Builds the subject of the missing-worksheet alert mail so it can later be reused for the Sent Items lookup and move operation.

AUDIT_MissingWorksheet.description: Writes an audit failure event for an uploaded Emergency Report missing the required worksheet.

Delay_Before_Get_Sent_Email_(MissingWork.description: Waits before searching Sent Items so that the alert mail can be indexed and found reliably.

Get_Sent_Email_By_Subject_(MissingWorksh.description: Searches Sent Items for the Agent 3 missing worksheet alert mail using the exact subject stored in AlertMailSubject.

SET_AlertMessageId__(MissingWorksheet).description: Stores the message id of the sent missing-worksheet alert mail so it can be moved to the Agent 3 Alerts folder.

Move_Email_(MissingWorksheet).description: Moves the Agent 3 alert mail from Sent Items to the Agent 3 Alerts folder.

MOVE_WorkFile_To_Rejected_(MissingWorksh.description:
Moves workbooks without the required worksheet to the Agent 3 rejected folder.

Preserves validation evidence and audit traceability.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:

No productive Emergency Report is released in this case.

IF_EmergencyContactsWorksheetExists.description: Checks whether the required Emergency Contacts worksheet was found within the uploaded workbook.

SET_AppResponseCode_(InvalidWorkbook).description: Sets the machine-readable response code for the invalid-workbook failure case.

inputs.name: AppResponseMessage

SET_AppResponseStatus_(InvalidWorkbook).description: Sets the Power Apps response status for the invalid-workbook failure case.

SET_AuditOutcome_(Failed)_-_Invalid_Work.description: Sets the overall audit outcome to Failed because the uploaded workbook is invalid.

AUDIT_InvalidWorkbook.description: Writes an audit failure event for an uploaded Emergency Report that could not be read as a valid workbook.

Delay_Before_Get_Sent_Email_(InvalidWork.description: Waits before searching Sent Items so that the alert mail can be indexed and found reliably.

Get_Sent_Email_By_Subject_(InvalidWorkbo.description: Searches Sent Items for the Agent 3 invalid workbook alert mail using the exact subject stored in AlertMailSubject.

Move_Email_(InvalidWorkbook).description: Moves the Agent 3 alert mail from Sent Items to the Agent 3 Alerts folder.

MOVE_WorkFile_To_Rejected_(InvalidWorkbo.description:
Moves the uploaded workbook to the Agent 3 rejected folder.

Preserves validation evidence and enables later investigation of invalid workbook submissions.

MAIL_Alert_(InvalidWorkbook).description: Sends a warning mail when the uploaded Emergency Report has an invalid file content.

IF_WorkbookReadable.description:
Checks whether the temporary workbook can be read by Excel Online.

If the worksheet list action fails or times out, the uploaded file is treated as an invalid workbook.

SCOPE_WorkbookValidation.description: Validates whether the uploaded file is a readable Excel workbook and contains all mandatory worksheets.

SCOPE_ProcessEmergencyReport.description: Processes the uploaded Emergency Report: creates a temporary work file, validates workbook readability and the mandatory worksheet, and releases the file to the productive target folder only after successful validation.

SCOPE_Audit_Success.description: Creates audit record after successful file storage.

GET_AgentSummaryRow_ForStep.description: Reads Agent 3's current Steps counters from Agent Audit Summary.

SET_NewStepsCount.description: Computes the incremented Steps counter value for this event's StepStatus.

PATCH_AgentSummaryRow_ForStep.description: Persists the incremented Steps counter for this event's StepStatus back to Agent Audit Summary.

GET_AgentSummaryRow_ForRun.description: Reads Agent 3's current Runs counters from Agent Audit Summary.

SET_NewRunsCount.description: Computes the incremented Runs counter value based on this run's final AuditOutcome.

PATCH_AgentSummaryRow_ForRun.description: Persists the incremented Runs counter for this run's final AuditOutcome back to Agent Audit Summary.

CREATE_WorkFile.description: Creates a temporary validation workbook in the Agent 3 work folder, used only for workbook readability/worksheet validation and controlled processing. Not consumed by Agent 1 and must be deleted after processing.

GET_WorkFileMetadata.description:
Retrieves SharePoint file metadata and identifier for the temporary Agent 3 work file.

Used for move, delete and audit operations.

HTTP_Recycle_WorkFile_CurrentRun.description: Recycles the current Agent 3 work file via SharePoint REST.

INC_StepCounter_(CleanupRecycled).description: Increments audit step for recycled work file cleanup.

INC_StepCounter_(CleanupStillLocked).description: Increments audit step for unresolved work file cleanup.

AUDIT_WorkFileCleanupStillLocked.description: Buffers warning audit event for still locked work file.

AUDIT_WorkFileCleanupRecycled.description: Buffers warning audit event for recycled work file cleanup.

IF_CleanupRequired_CurrentRun.description: Checks whether the temporary validation work file from the current run needs to be recycled (only when validation ultimately succeeded, since the productive Emergency Report has been released in that case).

SCOPE_WorkFileCleanup_CurrentRun.description: Handles cleanup of the current Agent 3 work file only.

SET_AuditOutcome_(Failed)_-_Invalid_File.description: Sets the overall audit outcome to Failed because the uploaded file extension is invalid.

SET_AppResponseCode_(InvalidExtension).description: Sets the machine-readable Power Apps response code for invalid file extensions.

inputs.name: AppResponseMessage
inputs.value: Invalid file type. Only .xlsx files are allowed.

SET_AppResponseMessage_(InvalidExtension.description: Sets the user-readable Power Apps response message for invalid file extensions.

SET_AppResponseStatus_(InvalidExtension).description: Sets the Power Apps response status for invalid file extensions.

AUDIT_InvalidExtension.description: Writes an audit failure event for an uploaded Emergency Report with invalid file extension.

Get_Sent_Email_By_Subject_(InvalidExtens.description: Searches Sent Items for the Agent 3 invalid-file-type alert mail using the exact subject stored in AlertMailSubject.

SET_AlertMessageId__(InvalidExtension).description: Stores the message id of the sent invalid-file-type alert mail so it can be moved to the Agent 3 Alerts folder.

Move_Email_(InvalidExtension).description: Moves the Agent 3 alert mail from Sent Items to the Agent 3 Alerts folder.

SET_AuditOutcome_EmailFolderFailed.description: Marks the run outcome as Failed when the mailbox evidence folder setup did not succeed. Treated as critical because it breaks housekeeping/archiving of processed alert mails, even if the Emergency Report upload itself succeeds later.

AUDIT_EmailFolderCreation_Failed.description: Buffers a Failed audit event when the mailbox evidence folder setup did not succeed, so the detailed Audit Trail shows this even if the Emergency Report upload itself is later processed successfully.

SET_AlertMailSubject_(EmailFolderCreatio.description: Builds the subject of the email-folder-creation-failed alert mail.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Agent 3 - Mailbox evidence folder setup failed.


The shared mailbox subfolders used for evidence/housekeeping ("PA Processed Mails" / "Agent 3 Alerts") could not be created or resolved. Housekeeping/archiving of processed alert mails will not work correctly until this is resolved. The uploaded Emergency Report will still be validated and processed independently of this issue.


User: @{variables('InitiatedBy')}
RunId: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']}

Please check the shared mailbox permissions and folder structure.

MAIL_Alert_(EmailFolderCreationFailed).description: Sends a critical alert mail when the mailbox evidence folder setup failed, so the operations team is notified without needing to actively monitor the Cockpit.

VAR_AlertEmailRecipient.description:
Default = DMP_Communication_Agent_Team@deutsche-boerse.com
Stores the central DMP communication agent alert recipient, aligned with Agent 1. Used for Agent 3 warning mails, operational support notification, and upload validation alerts.

VAR_AppResponseCode.description:
Default = UNHANDLED_ERROR

Stores the machine-readable response code returned to Power Apps.

Used for:
- Power Apps user feedback
- Error handling
- Audit correlation

VAR_AppResponseStatus.description:
Default = FAILED

Stores the processing result returned to Power Apps.

Possible values:
- SUCCESS
- WARNING
- FAILED

Used for:
- Power Apps notification routing
- Audit outcome mapping
- User feedback

variables.name: AppResponseMessage
variables.value: Emergency Report processing did not complete.

VAR_AppResponseMessage.description:
Default = Emergency Report processing did not complete.

Stores the user-readable response message returned to Power Apps.

Used for:
- Power Apps notification
- Error explanation
- Operational transparency

VAR_AlertMailSubject.description:
Stores the subject of the current Agent 3 alert mail.
Used for:

Sending alert mail
Locating the sent mail
Moving alert evidence to the Agent 3 alert folder

VAR_AlertMessageId.description:
Stores the message id of the sent Agent 3 alert mail after it has been located.
Used for:

Moving sent alert mail
Audit evidence
Operational traceability

VAR_AuditOutcome.description:
Default = Started

Stores the overall outcome of the current Agent 3 execution.

Possible values:
- Started
- Succeeded
- Warning
- Failed

Used for:
- AuditTrail.xlsx
- Run Summary
- Alert decision logic

VAR_AlertTargetFolderId.description:
Stores the Outlook folder id of the Agent 3 alert evidence folder.
Used for:

Moving alert mails
Agent 3 evidence handling
Operational audit trail

Get_DMP_Mailbox_Parent_Folder_ID.description: Resolves the mailbox folder ID of the processed-mails root folder so that Agent 3 subfolders can later be created and addressed.

Create_Mailbox_Subfolder_\"PA_Processed_.description: Creates the processed-mails root folder in the shared mailbox if it does not yet exist.

Create_Mailbox_Subfolder_\"Agent_3_Alert.description: Creates the dedicated Agent 3 Alerts mailbox subfolder below the processed-mails root folder if it does not yet exist.

Get_DMP_Mailbox_Subfolder_ID_for_\"Agent.description: Resolves the mailbox folder ID of the Agent 3 Alerts mailbox subfolder so that sent internal Agent 3 mails can later be moved there.

SET_AlertTargetFolderId.description:
Stores the mailbox folder ID of the Agent 3 Alerts folder.
Used for:
- Moving sent alert mails
- Audit evidence
- Operational traceability

E-Mail_Folder_creation.description: Ensures the Agent 3 Alerts mailbox evidence folder exists (creating the processed-mails root folder and the Agent 3 Alerts subfolder if needed) and resolves its folder id for later use when moving sent alert mails.

VAR_WorkbookValidationPassed.description:
Stores the workbook validation result.

Possible values:
- true
- false

Used for:
- Workbook validation
- Worksheet validation
- App response logic
- Audit decisions

VAR_WorkFileName.description:
Stores the temporary validation file name.

The file name is unique per flow run.

Used for:
- Temporary workbook creation
- Workbook validation
- Worksheet validation
- Cleanup after processing

Example:
WORK_<FlowRunId>.xlsx

RESPOND_To_PowerApps.description:
Returns the Agent 3 processing result to DMP COMMAND.

Used for:
- Power Apps success messages
- Power Apps error messages
- operational transparency
- user feedback after upload processing

VAR_StatusListName.description: Stores the SharePoint list used by DMP COMMAND to display current operational status information.

VAR_StatusAgentKey.description: Stores the unique dashboard identifier of Agent 3.

GET_StatusRow_Agent_03.description: Reads the Agent_03 dashboard status row.

GET_StatusRow_EmergencyReport.description: Reads the Emergency Report dashboard status row.

UPDATE_StatusRow_Agent_03.description: Stores the operational dashboard status of Agent 3.

UPDATE_StatusRow_EmergencyReport.description: Stores the Emergency Report infrastructure status.

For_each.description: Updates the dashboard status row for the Emergency Report infrastructure component alongside the main Agent 3 status row.

SCOPE_StatusRow_Update.description: Updates DMP COMMAND dashboard status rows for Agent 3 and Emergency Report infrastructure.

GET_DMP_Command_Configuration.description: Loads active DMP COMMAND configuration items.

VAR_OperationMode.description: Stores the current DMP COMMAND operating mode. Default value is PROD_NODMP until the value is resolved from configuration.

FILTER_Config_CurrentOperationMode.description: Finds the current DMP COMMAND operation mode configuration item.

SET_OperationMode.description: Stores the current DMP COMMAND operation mode resolved from DMP Command Configuration.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Agent 3 - Emergency Report processing failed.


The uploaded Emergency Report could not be stored in the configured SharePoint target location. The file was not made available for Agent 1 processing. Please review the flow run details and correct the issue.


User: @{variables('InitiatedBy')}
Source File: @{outputs('CMP_SourceFileName')}
Target File: @{trim(string(outputs('CMP_ConfigObject')?['EmergencyReportFileName']))}
Target Folder: @{trim(string(outputs('CMP_ConfigObject')?['EmergencyReportTargetFolder']))}
RunId: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']}

This notification was generated automatically by DMP Agent 3 (Emergency Report Management).

MAIL_Alert_(Audit_Failure).description: Sends technical failure alert from the shared DMP mailbox.

SET_AlertMailSubject_(Audit_Failure).description: Builds the subject of the generic technical-failure alert mail sent when the Agent 3 flow itself times out or fails unexpectedly.

Select_ConfigEntries.description: Maps each configuration row to a mode-resolved JSON key-value fragment, replacing the slow per-row loop with a single non-looping data operation.

CMP_ConfigJsonText.description: Completes the configuration JSON text by wrapping all resolved property fragments in braces.

CMP_ConfigObject.description: Converts the generated configuration JSON text into the central Agent 3 configuration object used throughout this flow.
